newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannonplast surges to record high.
newsitem.headline: Pannonplast surges to record high.

text.p: Hungarian plastics maker Pannonplast soared to a record high on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Thursday, benefiting from the bullish market sentiment, traders said.
Pannonplast soared to a new high of 5,324 forints after opening at 5,070, up from 5,065 at Wednesday's close. At 1212 GMT it stood at 5,323 forints.
"There is strong foreign buying interest in the stock," said Peter Nagy of Postabank Securities.
"The selling side is weak, as is for other papers," Balazs Szabo of Eastbrokers said.
Due to weak supply less than 20,000 units changed hands by 1212 GMT.
Tibor Papp of Raiffeisen said Pannonplast may have risen from similar reasons as the chemicals company TVK.
TVK said earlier on Thursday that it requested the state privatisation agency APV for five billion forints on the basis of a recent APV decision concerning the privatisation law.
Papp said the market could believe that Pannonplast, which is also a privatised company, may also have claims to the APV.
